tooltips.rxClientType: NSW Health hospitals add a police check, a Working with Children Check and vaccination evidence to every shift and placement.
tooltips.rxPharmacyApprovalNumber: The site's approval to supply PBS medicines. Separate from the Pharmacy Council number.
tooltips.rxPharmacyCouncilNumber: The site's registration with the Pharmacy Council of NSW, starting PC. Public hospitals have none.
tooltips.rxPharmacyApprovalExpiry: Pharmacy approval years end on 30 June.
tooltips.rxOtpDosingPoint: The site doses opioid treatment clients. Pharmacists working there need the OTP Standards attestation.
tooltips.rxPayrollDeclarationDate: The date the client gave its payroll tax declaration, for contractor arrangements.
tooltips.rxMmmCategory: The site's remoteness category, MM 1 to MM 7 (2023 edition).
tooltips.rxRequiredCredentials: Every shift or placement here must also hold these.
